name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new shingle roof?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new shingle roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new shingle roof typically comes with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty for the roofing materials and a contractor's warranty for the installation workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20 years to lifetime, covering defects in the shingles. Contractor warranties usually cover labor for a shorter period, often 5 to 10 years. It's important to understand the terms and conditions of both warranties before committing to a project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a manufacturer's warranty for materials (20 years to lifetime) and a contractor's warranty for workmanship (5-10 years).
